parsedContent.feedback: You correctly calculated the Profitability Index for both projects and chose Project B, but did not fully explain why Project B is preferable, such as mentioning its shorter payback period or higher NPV.
parsedContent.correctedAnswer: PI A = 163,305,000/105,000,000 = 1.5553, PI B = 167,595,000/105,000,000 = 1.596. Decision: Project B is to be undertaken for the following reasons: It has the shortest payback period; It has higher NPV; It has a higher Profitability Index.
